beats.name: hook
beats.said: A cook pours oil into the sea while a pirate ship closes in laughing.
beats.shown: Chef pours from a copper pot; camera follows the stream down the hull to the sea, then reveals pirate ship.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: Captain grabs the cook, shouts about boarding; cook ignores him and points at black clouds.
beats.shown: Pirate deck close-up, captain and chef two-shot, black clouds.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Captain protests, cook says to trust the oil; hook lands and pirates cheer the storm.
beats.shown: Captain shouting, chef pouring, grappling hook, pirate deck with cannons.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: Deep in the storm the crew ties down; he keeps pouring upwind as pirates board and a giant wave looms.
beats.shown: Dark blue storm sea, ship decks, swinging pirate, tiny ships under a wave.

beats.name: explainer
beats.said: Sailors carried storm oil; breath on soup ripples but oily patches stay smooth, so wind cannot grab it.
beats.shown: Chef in galley, oil tin, soup bowl top-down, yellow surface close-up.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: The wave reaches the oily patch and merely lifts the ship and sets it down.
beats.shown: Stormy sea, ship glowing underneath, rain, light shafts.

beats.name: ending
beats.said: Fifty yards behind, the wave curls and crushes the pirate deck.
beats.shown: Big wave curls over pirate ship, comic explosion and smoke, bobbing hat shapes.

hook.first_frame: Chef with white toque tips a copper pot, yellow oil stream falling onto a red ship hull; deep blue sky behind.
hook.first_3s: Camera follows the oil stream down the hull to the sea, splash shown, then swings out to reveal an orange-sailed pirate ship with a skull-cat figurehead.
hook.title_vs_first_line: Title asks why sailors carried storm oil; first line shows the odd action itself without naming the reason.

story.structure: act first, explain at the end
story.real_fact_core: Oil spread on water calms wave breaking because wind cannot grip a smooth oily surface, a real old seafaring practice.
story.authority_or_antagonist: Ship captain doubting him; pirate crew chasing them

tone.humour: Soup joke from the captain; pirates cheerfully welcoming a storm; comic explosion and floating hats at the end.
tone.deadpan_or_irony: Chef stays flat-faced and unbothered throughout, which contrasts with the panic around him.
tone.dialogue_style: Short reported lines inside narration; narrator voices both sides.

generation_evidence.observation: Pot, hull, porthole and oil stream keep consistent geometry through a long camera orbit; clean perspective.
Same hat badge, moustache and face outlines repeat identically between frames; only mouth/brow pose changes.
Galley props (lantern, porthole, pot, cabinet) keep rigid positions while camera drifts; crisp perspective.
STORM OIL label on tin stays crisp and spelled correctly; no warping text.
Explosion and smoke are flat polygonal comic shapes with black outlines, hat shapes float like 2D sprites.
Fast zoom out holds geometry steady; ship and tower stay stable while sea turns stormy, consistent with a camera move not a generated morph.
